title: Senior Manager/AGM - Engineering Design
company: Confidential (Will be discussed with right candidates)
description:
**About the Company**

A leading European MNC.

**About the Role**

Description of Job Role and Responsibilities

**Responsibilities**

* Pre-Sales & Post-Sales Engineering & Technical Leadership
* Own all technical pre-sales & post-sales activities for AHU projects.
* Perform and approve airflow and pressure-drop calculations for HVAC products
* Lead AHU sizing, configuration, and component selection including fans, coils (cwc/dx/hwc), filters, dampers, casings, and accessories.
* Prepare and approve technical proposals, GA drawings, datasheets, and selection reports.

* Product Certification
* Certification of Air Handling Units (AHUs) and Coils through Eurovent & AHRI
* Lead certification audits including software validation and factory audits
* Ensure compliance with international performance, testing, and quality standards
* Standards, Compliance & Governance
* Ensure full compliance with Eurovent, ASHRAE, IS, EN, and relevant global HVAC standards.
* Define and enforce pre-sales design standards, calculation methods, and approval workflows.
* Lead technical risk assessment and solution validation.

* Engineering Handover & Execution Readiness
* Ensure smooth handover from pre-sales/post-sales to productions.
* Document all technical commitments, assumptions, and performance guarantees.

* People & Capability Development
* Lead, mentor, and develop the AHU pre-sales & post sales design team.
* Build strong application engineering and technical competency across the team.

* Cross-Functional & Customer Engagement
* Collaborate with Sales, Manufacturing, Sourcing, Quality, and Project teams.
* Lead technical discussions with customers, consultants, and PMC teams

**Qualifications**

* Academic Background: BE (Mechanical)
* Number of years of Professional Experience required: 15 years of post-qualification

**Required Skills**

* Experience and Skills required:
* 15+ years of experience with 8+ years in AHU / HVAC engineering & pre-sales.
* Expert knowledge of AHU design, thermal & airflow calculations, psychrometrics, and HVAC systems.
* Strong command of international standards: Eurovent, ASHRAE, IS, EN.
* Proven leadership of engineering (Pre-sales & Post-sales design teams).
* Experience in Engineer-to-Order (ETO) environments.

**Key Personal Skills:**

* Technical Leadership
* Application Engineering Excellence
* Customer & Commercial Acumen
* Decision Making & Risk Management
* Cross-Functional Collaboration
* Language Skills required:
* Hindi and English – Business fluent
